high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the official account of Prime Minister Imran Khan, as indicated by the username "imrankhan.pti" at the top left corner. The post highlights global recognition for Pakistan's green initiatives, specifically focusing on the "Ten Billion Tree Tsunami" project. Header: The header reads: "Prime Minister Imran Khan's GREEN INITIATIVES RECEIVE GLOBAL RECOGNITION." The text is bold and prominently displayed, emphasizing the significance of the initiative. Main Image: The central image shows a lush green forest
